data.text:
— with a faithful account:

- The verbatim `cmd /c del /f
/s /q zc-sub` was run first, but in Git Bash
the `/c` switch gets path-mangled, so cmd
just opened and closed without executing the deletion. I re-ran it as
`cmd //c "del /f /s /q zc-sub"` (same command, properly escaped), which is what

actually executed.
- Result: the file inside was deleted (`zc-sub\zc-inside
itself remains, since `del` only removes files, not
